Name: Tunnel System
Author: nan0penguin
Description:
[color=#b6d7a8][size=2][b][size=4] ﻿ ﻿Overview[/size]
[/b][/size][/color][size=2]
Your farm is already pretty large and, especially when you have custom farm maps installed, it can be quite difficult getting around the map. With my Tunnel System, you can easiely get from one point to another and still keep you gigantic farms


[size=4] ﻿ ﻿[b][color=#b6d7a8]Current & Future Features[/color][/b][/size]

Current version includes
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]A new cellar[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=2]Access to the greenhouse including a bigger greenhouse[/size]
[*][size=2]Access to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3067]Jessebots 'Secret Gardens Greenhouse'[/url]﻿ including the garden itself[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=2]Conditional map loading:[/size]
[size=2]- No stair in greenhouse before 3 house upgrade
- Better compatibility with farm mods
[/size][/list][list]
[*][size=2]Access to secret woods[/size]
[/list][size=2]Things planned for the next update
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]A bigger cellar with more usable space[/size]
[*][size=2]Compatibility with:[/size]
[size=2]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1797]Erossavia Tree Happy Greenhouse[/url]﻿
[/size][/list][size=2]Other planned additions for later updates
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Access to the mines and minecart system (probably with extended minecarts[/size]
[*][size=2]More decoration in already added parts[/size]
[*][size=2]Access to the sewers[/size]
[*][size=2]Access to the bathhouse
[/size]
[/list][size=2]

[color=#b6d7a8][b] ﻿[size=4] ﻿Compatibility[/size][/b][/color]

Tunnel System is compatible right out of the box with:
[/size][list]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3067]Secret Garden Greenhouse[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2571]DeepWoods[/url]﻿[/size]
[/list][size=2]To be compatible with other mods you just need to replace their content.json with the new ones provided by me. Mods supported that way are:
[/size][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1531][size=2]Immersive Farm 2[/size][/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2364][size=2]Even More Secret Woods[/size][/url]﻿
[/list][size=2]Although I'm adding compatibility for as much mods as possible, it just isn't possible for every mod. Mods changing following, except the already listed ones are currently not supported:
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Greenhouse[/size]
[*][size=2]Cellar[/size]
[*][size=2]Woods[/size]
[/list][size=2]If you want a mod added you can alway request it in the posts section and I'll try to add it with the next update



More Ideas?
